academic_authority.CANONICAL_CHEMISTRY_TRUTH: Owns scientific concepts, prereqs, chemistry equations, representations, conditions, exceptions, textbook sequencing, scientific checks, all Core1-family academic truth
academic_authority.QRT_TEMPLATE: Owns 7 operations * 4 bands, decisive act, slots X/Y/Z/W, protected work, wrong-idea design and H1-H3/S1-S3/P1-P3/M1-M3 review criteria; cannot define Chemistry syllabus
academic_authority.CHEMISTRY_BLUEPRINT: Owns subject-wide model/representation/validation methods; cannot override shared QRT protected W or official syllabus
academic_authority.TOPIC_ADAPTER: Owns scoped bindings to canonical concept IDs and task instances; may not silently rewrite concepts or QRT specs
academic_authority.SOURCE_CUSTODY: Owns original question text, official identity, original figure/answer-key evidence for Core2 only; question claims are not proof of academic truth
academic_authority.AUTHOR_PRACTICE: Clearly labeled authored tasks allowed for Core2A/B according to current role and exposure contracts; never impersonate exam originals

role_boundaries.CORE1: Foundational semantic orientation, never the whole textbook
role_boundaries.CORE1A: Full detailed scientific exposition; derivations, representations, experiments, counterexamples, complete solutions and independent checks; do not start from an exam answer key
role_boundaries.CORE1B: Elicit exactly the Core1A taught inferences with predict, attempt, reconstruct, diagnose, repair and boundary; first response protected before feedback
role_boundaries.CORE2: Source-faithful only after eligible custody and rights; never used to define canonical Chemistry truth
role_boundaries.CORE2A: Supported application grounded in canonical science and eligible reviewed demand or explicit authored practice
role_boundaries.CORE2B: Genuine changed-demand transfer requiring established prior exposure and protected new decision

textbook_contract.requirement: A meaningful demand is a distinct observable scientific act, not three cosmetic number variations
textbook_contract.D3_policy: Important bridge between ideas/representations/models must remain learner-owned; component concepts may be supported
textbook_contract.D4_policy: Decisive model/strategy/exception/warrant must remain learner-owned; novel context must actually demand a deeper inference
textbook_contract.school_level_scope: Exam scope through Class X; classify CORE_CANDIDATE vs EXTENSION vs ENRICHMENT; extra theory not retroactively made official

qrt_contract.protected_W: All pre-attempt hints and pictures must preserve learner decisive act W

change_policy.append: Add stable subtopic/instance identity, maintain old identifiers, declare new source and canonical refs; minor version if backward compatible
change_policy.amend: Change canonical science through its own authority and version; revise dependent adapter and generated outputs, preserve old attempt revision binding
change_policy.breaking: Major version plus migration map and old attempt preservation
change_policy.blueprint_gap: Submit reproducible gap with missing slot, example, candidate solution and affected cells; Agent A owns common revision; no silent edits by Agent B
change_policy.approval: Freeze is a technical handoff for parallel authoring; academic/QRT/source/merge/deploy authority remains separate
